title: A common etale constant derived model trivializes on weakly contractible affines
statement: Let X be any scheme, R any commutative ring, L a derived etale R-module sheaf and E an object of D(R). Suppose an etale covering {V_i to X} identifies L restricted to each V_i with the constant realization of this same E. For every affine weakly contractible pro-etale object W over X, the comparison pullback of L restricted to W is isomorphic to the constant realization of E on W. Neither X nor W is required to be connected or nonempty, and E is not required to be perfect.

proof.text: Construct a finite affine etale refinement of the pullback cover using QuasiCompactCover.exists_hom. Form its finite disjoint coproduct T over W. The coproduct map T to W is an etale covering; Yoneda and separatedness make its representable map epi, so weak contractibility supplies a section s of T over W. For each coproduct component, transport the given local derived isomorphism along the factorization through the original cover. The components are pairwise disjoint clopen and cover the coproduct, so exact upper/lower-star adjunctions and the localization zero lemma show that the unit from a derived object to the product of lower-star upper-star restrictions is an isomorphism. Assemble the componentwise isomorphisms, then pull the resulting isomorphism back along s and use s followed by T to W equals the identity. All constructions are natural in the derived objects and work for empty or disconnected W. The comparison and constant transports use the existing arbitrary-coefficient ProEtale.comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso, comparisonUpperStarConstantSheafIso and constantSheafCompUpperStarIso APIs, rather than finite-coefficient ringed transports. The derived assembly uses preservesFiniteColimits_lowerStar_of_isClosed_range, isZero_mapDerivedCategoryUpperStar_obj_mapDerivedCategory_lowerStar and jointlyReflectIsomorphisms_mapDerivedCategory. Subcanonicity and localization use the existing GaloisEvaluation and Localization APIs directly.

theorem etale_constant_models_on_weaklyContractible
    (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (L : _root_.DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)))
    (E : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))
    (𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage X)
    (hlocal : ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, Nonempty
      ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) (𝒰.f i)).mapDerivedCategory.obj L ≅
        (constantSheaf (𝒰.X i).smallEtaleTopology
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E))
    (W : X.ProEt) [IsAffine W.left]
    (hW : (ProEt.topology X).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} W) :
    Nonempty
      ((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) W.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj L) ≅
        (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology W.left) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)
